summary: Jaraad Kamal graduated from the University of Maryland College Park with a degree in Computer Science in May 2023 with a GPA of 4.0.

He is a certifed AWS Solutions Architect and has expertise in Python, C, C#, and Java. His current favorite programming language is C. He has hands-on experience with all aspects of the software development lifecycle including software testing. He also has experience with networking and cybersecurity.

In his spare time, he works on video game development and other programming projects. Most video game development is through C# and the unity framework. His other programming skills include C/C++ Ruby, Golang, Rust, Lisp.

values.name: JCaml
description: This is my compilers project that focused on creating a programming language called JCaml. It is a functional programming language that is similar to Racket.
The language is written in Racket, C and x86 Assembly. This was a massive compilers project.

values.name: Ant Optimization
description: This project creates an approximate solution to the traveling salesman problem in polynomial time.
The program uses my approach of Ant Colony Optimization which is an algorithm that models ants foraging.

values.name: Rubik's Analysis
description: I created this project as a simple tutorial for introductory data science.
It is a project that explored Rubik's cube competitons and analyzed which competitions were performing statistically worse.
